failure_a_runaway_retry.symptom: Single slow request causes CPU/memory spike and hundreds of retry logs
failure_a_runaway_retry.root_cause: Unbounded retry loop (maxRetries removed or set to Infinity) without a hard retry cap or maxDelay bound, spawning endless timers and exhausting event-loop/memory resources.
failure_a_runaway_retry.remediation: Enforce strict maxRetries=3 cap and maxDelayMs=2000 upper bound in retryWithBackoff, plus defensive input validation rejecting non-finite or excessive retry caps.

failure_b_circuit_never_heals.symptom: Circuit breaker opens properly on outage, but never reconnects after dependency restarts
failure_b_circuit_never_heals.root_cause: Broken half-open transition (absurdly high resetTimeout or faulty custom state machine refusing to transition HALF_OPEN -> CLOSED on successful probe).
failure_b_circuit_never_heals.remediation: Use opossum with calibrated resetTimeout (30000ms) and verify automated Closed -> Open -> Half-Open -> Closed transitions via integration drill.

failure_c_synchronized_stampede.symptom: Recovering dependency is repeatedly knocked back offline by synchronized retry waves at identical timestamps
failure_c_synchronized_stampede.root_cause: Missing randomized jitter in exponential backoff calculation (fixed 100/200/400/800ms intervals cause thundering herd convergence across concurrent requests).
failure_c_synchronized_stampede.remediation: Apply randomized jitter (+/- jitterMs or full jitter) on every backoff delay so concurrent retries spread evenly over the recovery window.
